page.overview:
Who is Abrika?

Abrika is a fictional board member of the criminal shadow organization SPECTRE. A minor antagonist, he briefly appeared in the 2015 James Bond film Spectre, portrayed by actor Adel Bencherif.

Abrika is one of the SPECTRE members who are present at the secretive meeting at the Palazzo Cadenza, in Rome, following the death of their operative Marco Sciarra by the hands of James Bond, who infiltrates the meeting. Seeting on the right side of the table face with Dr. Vogel, Abrika hears Moreau's reports of the attacks on Hamburg and Indonesia as part of Ernst Stavro Blofeld's plot to take control of the world's intelligence systems through Max Denbigh's Nine Eyes Committee. He would later hear of Vogel's reports of human trafficking and prostitution. After Vogel finishes her report, Moreau announces to anyone who would like to fill in for Sciarra to kill the Pale King after his failed mission in Mexico, to which Guerra offers to take over. Moreau then asks if anyone else wants to take over the mission, to which Mr. Hinx arrives on cue. Abrika then watches as Hinx kills Guerra to ensure that he would do the job pretty well of tracking down Mr. White. Eventually, Blofeld detects Bond's presence and exposes him, forcing the nervous spy to escape after killing Lorenzo. Abrika is not seen again.

Despite not appearing in the film, Abrika is presumably killed alongside the rest of SPECTRE when Valdo Obruchev releases the Project Heracles bioweapon.
